description: Land Title Settlement Dept -T.R. Hirimbura, Bope Poddala D/S/D, Galle District (25-14-204-00028)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively about land title registration. It contains declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining the ownership of specific land parcels, listing owner names, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances (e.g., mortgages, rights of way). The document is explicitly published under "PART III - LANDS" and operates under the Registration of Title Act. This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers land registrations, titles, ownership, and related encumbrances.
